construction.physical_operation: Select complete centrally symmetric owners at an actual marked host face, edge or vertex. Retain all60 host walls and an actual directed separating plane for every pair. Reconstruct every owner translation together. Continued returns replace ports only by separating faces of the realized pair. All owners retain the same proper canonical orientation.
construction.pair_rule: Each pair requires a dot(c_j-c_i)>=h_P(a)+h_P(-a), using actual canonical supports.
construction.native_clearance: Dilate exact raw centers by1+1/500000, and use host scale(1+1/500000)*exact_nominal+1/500000.

contribution.method: Complete paired-ring antiprism, marked-cell Catalan and staggered-prism constructions with fixed physical frames, source decoders and finite boundary costs.
